candidats.description: In total, 22 electrical sockets on a gray-painted wall in a school building in Lillesand , Norway, with three black electric power cables (charging cords for floor polishers) plugged in. AC power plugs and sockets connect devices to mains electricity to supply them with electrical power. A plug is the connector attached to an electrically-operated device, often via a cable. A socket (also known as a receptacle or outlet) is fixed in place, often on the internal walls of buildings, and is connected to an AC electrical circuit.
